name: Pack for a week using only a carry-on
blurb: A capsule wardrobe, packing method and toiletry discipline that fits a week into 40 litres. It saves hours at every airport for the rest of your life.
gear: A carry-on bag within your airline’s dimensions
steps: Build a capsule wardrobe in one colour palette so everything combines: roughly three bottoms, five tops, one layer, one jacket.
Choose fabrics that resist wrinkles and dry overnight — merino and synthetics rather than cotton.
Learn a packing method: roll casual clothes, use the bundle method for shirts, and use cubes to compress and organise.
Wear your bulkiest items — boots and jacket — on the plane.
Plan to do laundry once mid-trip. That single decision halves what you need to carry.
Weigh and measure the bag before leaving, and keep liquids in a clear bag at the top.
tips: You will not wear the "just in case" outfit. Take it out.
Two pairs of shoes is almost always enough, and one of them is on your feet.
Check the specific airline’s carry-on size and weight limit; budget carriers enforce theirs strictly.
proof: You complete a week-long trip with only a carry-on and never wish you had checked a bag.
